messages:
alex-k: Hey team — quick payroll question. I moved from CA -> OR on 2025-07-12 and updated my address, but my 7/31 paycheck still had full-year CA state withholding. Can payroll re-run withholding allocation for the year and confirm how that shows on my W-2?

jen-people-ops: @alex-k thanks for flagging — sorry for the hassle. @samir-payroll can you advise next steps? :thinking_face:

samir-payroll: Hey — we can split state wages on the W-2 (multiple state entries in boxes 15-17) or issue a corrected W-2 (W-2c) if taxes were actually withheld incorrectly. Need a few things from you to start: last 4 SSN, employee ID, and proof of move date (lease/utility or relocation form).

alex-k: Thanks. emp ID is `48291`, last4 SSN `6789`. Attaching lease scan in the ticket.

payroll-bot: Created ticket PR-2025-391: "CA/OR midyear withholding allocation - Alex K (48291)" assigned to samir-payroll.

samir-payroll: Got it. I see 100% CA withholding through payroll run 2025-07-15. Process we'll do: 1) confirm move date and effective payroll change, 2) reclassify wages pre/post-move, 3) compute state tax liability and refund or credit if applicable, 4) decide if W-2c is required (depends on whether boxes 15-17 or state withholding amounts need correction). Usually we can handle allocation without W-2c if withheld correctly but wages need multi-state reporting.

maria-l: Quick note from manager side — we approved the remote relocation and the relocation form is on file (People Ops > Relocations > Alex K). Happy to confirm move date if payroll needs a manager attestation.

alex-k: Thanks. Timeline? I need to file state returns for OR and CA and want to avoid surprises at tax time.

samir-payroll: We aim to finish the review within 7 business days after we verify docs. If reclassification affects state withholdings materially, we'll either arrange withholding adjustments on upcoming runs or advise on filing. For W-2: expect multi-state entries (CA and OR) on the original W-2 if we just allocate wages. If a W-2c is needed we'll issue it — that can take a couple weeks to process depending on state forms.

jen-people-ops: Action items: alex - confirm lease doc uploaded to ticket; samir - run allocation & share draft of how it will show on W-2; maria - confirm manager attestation in ticket. I'll follow up end of week. :+1:

alex-k: Lease uploaded. Thank you all.

samir-payroll: Reviewing now. Example of how multiple states appear on W-2 (for illustration only):

```
Box 15: CA    2025   28500.00
Box 15: OR    2025   17500.00
Box 16: CA wages   28500.00
Box 16: OR wages   17500.00
Box 17: CA tax     1800.00
Box 17: OR tax     800.00
```

samir-payroll: I'll post actual numbers to the ticket once computed. If you have any state-specific filings planned, CC payroll on those so we can coordinate.

jen-people-ops: Thanks, team. Marking this resolved in Slack for now; will update the ticket with final outcome. :wave:
